rationale: Darren brings 30 years of e-commerce and payments infrastructure expertise plus deep conviction around privacy-preserving technology and blockchain architecture—skills directly relevant as Ethan builds consumer AI at Moondream. Both are San Francisco-based founders at an early stage where Darren's operational experience scaling marketplaces and managing complex technical infrastructure could help Ethan navigate the challenges of shipping AI products, while Ethan's ML and computer vision work represents the kind of emerging tech stack that could inform Darren's next infrastructure bets.
intro_message: Darren Mckeeman, meet Ethan reid — you're both SF-based founders solving infrastructure challenges on different frontiers (payments + privacy vs. computer vision), and Darren's 20+ years shipping e-commerce systems could be useful as Ethan scales Moondream.
